memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Honor your father and your mother, as the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live long and that it may go well with you in the land the Lord your God is giving you. - Deut 5:16 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This is the first commandment that comes with a promise attached. God ties the honouring of parents to a life that "may go well" in the land He was giving Israel. In the covenant setting, this was a national promise about flourishing in the promised land — a community that honours its elders and passes down faith from generation to generation will be a stable, healthy society. Where family bonds break down, a nation unravels.

We should be careful here. This was first a promise to Israel about their life in Canaan, not a mechanical guarantee that every obedient child will have a long, trouble-free life. Yet the principle behind it reflects God's unchanging character: He values honour, order, and love within the family, and He weaves blessing into a life that respects the ones He placed over us.

The New Testament picks up this very command and applies it to us, calling it the first command with a promise (Eph 6:1-3). Honouring parents can be complicated — some had painful homes, some carry deep wounds. Honour does not always mean agreement or blind obedience, but it does mean treating them with respect and care as those who bear God's image. And Jesus Himself, even from the cross, made sure His mother was cared for (John 19:26-27). Following Him, we learn to honour well.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- How am I showing honour and care to my parents, whatever our relationship has been?
- Where might God be inviting me to grow in respect toward those in authority over me?
- How does Jesus' example shape the way I treat my family?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, teach me to honour my parents in a way that pleases You, with respect and care. Where there has been pain, bring healing, and help me follow the example of Jesus who honoured even from the cross. Amen.
